pages.title: Winner!
pages.text: Plays when you win the championship, and ends in TV static. The game is a show on the Outlaw Sports channel, as EA Sports games of the time looked like TV. Skitchin' (EA, 1994), Mega Drive / Genesis. Music by Jeff van Dyck.

pages.title: On air
pages.text: The hosts are The Spectre, Crash Cassidy and Barb Banger. The faces of the hosts and racers are the team's own, digitised; designer Dave Warfield is the skater Fester.

pages.title: The scores
pages.text: 47 reviews, 78% on average. GamePro: 19.5 of 20. EGM's five reviewers: 5 to 7 of 10. A German magazine misnamed it 'Stitching' and gave it 47%.
